name: RotateCoor
formula: =LAMBDA(arr,rx,ry,deg,LET(theta, deg * PI() / 180, cosTheta, COS(theta), sinTheta, SIN(theta), RotatePointX, LAMBDA(point, LET(x, INDEX(point, 1, 1), y, INDEX(point, 1, 2), xPrime, rx + cosTheta * (x - rx) + sinTheta * (y - ry), xPrime)), RotatePointY, LAMBDA(point, LET(x, INDEX(point, 1, 1), y, INDEX(point, 1, 2), yPrime, ry - sinTheta * (x - rx) + cosTheta * (y - ry), yPrime)), xCoor, BYROW(arr, RotatePointX), yCoor, BYROW(arr, RotatePointY), output, HSTACK(xCoor, yCoor), output))
